Context: 12. Definition of Non-Consulting Service

'Non-Consulting Service' means procurement distinguished from 'Consultancy Services', involving physical, measurable deliverables/ outcomes, where performance standards can be clearly identified and consistently applied, other than goods or works, except those incidental or consequential to the service, and includes maintenance, hiring of vehicle, outsourcing of building facilities management, security, photocopier service, janitor, office errand services, drilling, aerial photography, satellite imagery,
